newsitem.title: HONG KONG: COSCO Property makes cash offer for Shun Shing.
newsitem.headline: COSCO Property makes cash offer for Shun Shing.

text.p: COSCO (H.K.) Property Development Ltd said on Friday it would make a HK$0.72 per share cash offer for Shun Shing Holdings Ltd after raising its Shun Shing stake to 61 percent from 30 percent.

COSCO (H.K.) Property said in a statement that its wholly owned True Smart International Ltd unit had agreed to buy 208.32 million shares, or about 31 percent of Shun Shing's issued share capital, at HK$0.72 per share from Golden Success Ltd.
COSCO (H.K) Property, a unit of COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd, said it would pay the HK$149.99 million for 208.32 million shares in cash on completion of the deal.
The company bought 201.6 million shares, or 30 percent of Shun Shing's issued share capital, at HK$0.315 in December.
Trading in shares of Shun Shing was suspended on Wednesday and was due to resume on Friday. The stock rose HK$0.14 to HK$0.99 on Tuesday.
COSCO (H.K.) Property said Shun Shing had made a loss after tax of HK$76.5 million for the year ended August 31, 1996, compared with a loss of HK$49.7 million the previous year.
Shun Shing's main business consists of construction work in Hong Kong and Singapore, property investments and property development in Hong Kong, Canada and China.
COSCO (H.K.) Property said it wanted to consolidate control in the company "so as to better formulate business strategies".
It said it had no intention, at least in the coming six months, to inject any material assets into Shun Shing or dispose of any of Shun Shing's material assets.
After the offer, four directors would resign from the board, it said.

COSCO (H.K.) Property said it would nominate six directors, four of which are senior managers at COSCO (HK) Group or at China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co. COSCO (Hong Kong) is the holding company of COSCO Pacific Ltd.

Golden Success, owned by Shun Shing chairman Tse Yip Sang, would see its stake in Shun Shing reduced to about five percent from a current 36 percent. Golden Success intends to hold the remaining stake as an investment.
COSCO (H.K.) Property said it intended to maintain listing of Shun Shing shares on the Hong Kong stock exchange.
